The '''truncated square antiprism''' one in an infinite series of truncated antiprisms, constructed as a [[truncation (geometry)|truncated]] [[square antiprism]]. It has 18 faces, 2 octagons, 8 hexagons, and 8 squares.

== Gyroelongated triamond square bicupola==
If the hexagons are folded, it can be constructed by regular polygons. Or each folded hexagon can be replaced by two [[triamond]]s, adding 8 edges (56), and 4 faces (32). This form is called a ''gyroelongated triamond square bicupola''.<ref>[https://www.interocitors.com/polyhedra/Triamonds Convex Triamond Regular Polyhedra]</ref>
:[[File:Gyroelongated_triamond_square_bicupola.png|240px]]

=== Snub square antiprism ===
Although it can't be made by all regular planar faces, its [[Alternation (geometry)|alternation]] is the [[Johnson solid]], the [[snub square antiprism]].
:[[File:Snub_square_antiprism_colored.png|240px]]
